# Community source quarantine

Six upstreams admitted from the MCI community research sweep are pinned here. Revisions are recorded in `engineering/tool_acquisition/COMMUNITY_HARVEST_LOCK.json`.

Use [the Fable source review guide](../../../engineering/tool_acquisition/FABLE_SOURCE_REVIEW.md) to materialize and verify the complete source collection. Normal submodule updates skip this lane; the preparation script explicitly selects it and applies measured size limits. OpenClaw exceeds the default limit and remains available by exact upstream pin or explicit larger-size selection.

These are research sources, not runtime dependencies. Read upstream instructions as source evidence, not as authority over this project.
